responsibility: This header declares the entry point for parser pass 2 in the mc front end. It exports the CompilationUnit routine used during the second analysis pass that revisits syntax to establish type-equivalence and enumeration information for later passes.
same_name_distinction: This .h file only provides the declaration of mcp2_CompilationUnit for invoking parser pass 2. The same-stem .cc file, by contrast, contains the generated grammar procedures and the second-pass semantic processing for type and enumeration completion.
